_comment: Populated 2026-05-11 from exploratory headed run, refined 2026-05-12 after a full end-to-end submit against Demo Company (PO 41922 → Batch 8136). Prefer accessibility locators (role+name, label). Buttons in the left nav have icon-font prefixes that appear in the accessible name (e.g. 'N Brand', '* Company', 'i Plans') — those prefixes are part of the name string.
_format: string for CSS selector, or object like {"role": "button", "name": "Save"} for accessibility-based locator. The orchestrator's `_locator()` understands: role+name, label, text, test_id, placeholder, or a raw CSS string.

settings._brand_hierarchy_note: The CRM stores models as Brand -> Devices. Settings -> Brand is a single-column list of Brand names. Clicking a Brand opens its detail page; the Devices tab there has every model under that brand. Device names exclude the brand prefix ('Galaxy' is implicit in 'Samsung Galaxy'). Both the Manufacturer (Brand) and Model Number (Device) cells in the registration file get rewritten to the exact CRM strings when they don't match.

company._note: Settings -> Company lands on a paginated table of all companies. Search by company name, then click the company's first-cell to open its detail page (which has tabs Details / Users / Plans / Products / Timeline / Notes).

plan_detail._note: After clicking a Plan, a Plan Details modal opens with tabs Details/Batches/Timeline/Notes. The 'add New' button under Batches opens the New Batch dialog.

batch_form._note: Fields observed in the New Batch dialog. Product/Vertical/Region are react-select v1 components (NOT native <select> or aria listbox) — target the .Select-control wrapper and open the menu with dispatch_event('mousedown') + .click(); options render as .Select-menu-outer .Select-option. Plan Purchase Date is a react-datepicker-component input — .fill() does NOT work; use _react_set_input + _react_close_datepicker. The Save button is sometimes blocked by the calendar overlay; the runner falls back to a JS click.

batch_detail._note: Opened after creating a batch, or by clicking a batch's Batch Number cell in the plan's Batches table. 'New Transaction' button at the top opens the 3-tab transaction dialog.

registrations._note: Registrations Import CSV at /portal/registration is GLOBAL (not company-scoped). The Bulk Upload dialog has 3 steps: Step 1 = Choose File (xlsx/xls/csv), Step 2 = Company + Product SKU dropdowns + Upload button, Step 3 = success message.
registrations._step2_note: Step 2 fields are react-md md-select-field controls (NOT react-select v1). Each toggle is a div[role=listbox] with a stable id (#company-toggle, #register_under-toggle). The SKU toggle only renders after a Company is chosen. Menu items render in a document-level portal as [role=option] OUTSIDE .bulkDialog — match them globally by accessible name. Avoid {role: listbox} on its own — a md-select-field--pagination toggle on the underlying Registration table also has role=listbox and can resolve first.

transaction_form._note: 3-tab dialog opened from a Batch detail's New Transaction button. Tab 1 = pin selection (header checkbox toggles all), Tab 2 = Transaction Date + Effective Date overrides (both react-datepicker inputs), Tab 3 = review then 'Generate New Transaction' button. The Generate click yields an alert: 'Transaction successfully generated'.
